items.quote: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us?
items.claim: Abimelech called Abraham to him and confronted him about what he had done to Abimelech and his people.

items.quote: what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin?
items.claim: Abimelech said Abraham had brought a great sin on him and his kingdom, and asked how he had wronged Abraham to deserve it.
items.mechanism: Abraham's actions exposed Abimelech and his kingdom to a great sin

items.quote: thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.
items.claim: Abimelech said Abraham's actions toward him broke accepted standards of conduct.
